Thailand
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Budapest
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport NO (up to 30 days)
Diplomatic biometric passport NO (up to 30 days)
Citizens of the Kingdom of Thailand need a visa when entering, leaving or crossing the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The visa is issued in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Citizens of the Kingdom of Thailand, holders of diplomatic and official passports, are exempt from the obligation to obtain visas for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for up to 30 days.
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, holders of diplomatic and official passports, are exempt from the obligation to obtain visas for entry, exit, transit and stay in the territory of the Kingdom of Thailand for up to 30 days.
